_comment: Scripture questions saved from the Hot Potato deck when that deck became purely performative.
Every question was verified against fetched KJV and WEB text (api.getbible.net/v2), cross-checked in ASV and YLT. The NIV was NOT consulted (copyrighted, not in that source).

Six refs were corrected during that check because the original passage did not state something the question said: Acts 28:1 -> Acts 27:41-28:3; 1 Samuel 17:4 -> 17:4-10; John 2:9 -> 2:1-11; Matthew 26:36 -> 26:36-50; Acts 18:2-3 -> 18:1-3; Genesis 37:3 -> 35:10; 37:1-3. Exodus 4:14-16 gained 4:30, and Daniel 3:23 became 3:20-23, so that the doer is stated rather than inferred.
Where translations differ on the answer the answer carries both forms: Melita (Malta), Zacchaeus (Zaccheus), Abednego (Abed-nego), Mount Sinai (Horeb).
The accuracy rule: the answer is STATED in the verse, never inferred, summed or deduced. The "quoted" fields are the phrases that carry the answer, as read in each translation.
Not used by any game yet. The engine's four-screen knowledge path (core/views.js) is what a deck of these would use.
